definitions.explanation: A shop that specializes in selling fresh meat. {精肉|せいにく} refers to dressed meat (meat that has been cut and prepared for sale), and {店|てん} means shop.

examples.japanese: {精肉店|せいにくてん}で{牛肉|ぎゅうにく}を{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought beef at the butcher shop.

examples.japanese: この{精肉店|せいにくてん}のコロッケは{有名|ゆうめい}だ。
examples.english: The croquettes at this butcher shop are famous.

examples.japanese: {商店街|しょうてんがい}の{精肉店|せいにくてん}では、{注文|ちゅうもん}に{合|あ}わせて{肉|にく}を{切|き}ってくれる。
examples.english: At the butcher shop in the shopping street, they cut the meat to order.

notes:
A compound of {精肉|せいにく} (dressed meat; butchered meat) and {店|てん} (shop). Traditional butcher shops in Japanese shopping streets ({商店街|しょうてんがい}) often also sell prepared items like コロッケ (croquettes) and メンチカツ (minced meat cutlets), which are popular take-out snacks.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {精肉店|せいにくてん}で{買|か}う: to buy at a butcher shop
- {精肉店|せいにくてん}のコロッケ: butcher shop croquettes
- {町|まち}の{精肉店|せいにくてん}: the local butcher shop

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {肉屋|にくや}: butcher; meat shop — more colloquial and commonly used in everyday speech
- {鮮魚店|せんぎょてん}: fish shop — the equivalent for seafood
- {八百屋|やおや}: greengrocer — vegetable and fruit shop in a shopping street
